description: Source code for the AudioEndpoint class in the Android AAudio system, managing audio data queues, command messages, and buffer configurations.

classes.name: AudioEndpoint
classes.description: Manages audio data queues, command messaging, and buffer configurations for audio streaming.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the AudioEndpoint with provided descriptor and direction, setting up command and data queues.

methods.name: configureDataQueue
methods.description: Sets up the data queue with specified descriptor and direction, initializing buffer and counters.

methods.name: readUpCommand
methods.description: Reads a command message from the up command queue.

methods.name: getEmptyFramesAvailable
methods.description: Returns the number of empty frames available in the data queue, optionally considering wrapping buffer.

methods.name: getFullFramesAvailable
methods.description: Returns the number of full data frames available in the data queue, optionally considering wrapping buffer.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data frames from the data queue into a buffer.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data frames from a buffer into the data queue.

methods.name: advanceWriteIndex
methods.description: Advances the write index of the data queue by specified frames.

methods.name: advanceReadIndex
methods.description: Advances the read index of the data queue by specified frames.

methods.name: setDataReadCounter
methods.description: Sets the read counter for the data queue.

methods.name: getDataReadCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the current read counter of the data queue.

methods.name: setDataWriteCounter
methods.description: Sets the write counter for the data queue.

methods.name: getDataWriteCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the current write counter of the data queue.

methods.name: setBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Sets the buffer size in frames, adjusting the threshold accordingly.

methods.name: getBufferSizeInFrames
methods.description: Returns the current buffer size in frames.

methods.name: getBufferCapacityInFrames
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer in frames.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs current read/write counters for debugging.
